member.name: M:Uclh.XRT.Esapi.Core.ScannerCouchInfo.GetPhotonPbtReferencePositions(VMS.TPS.Common.Model.API.Image)
member.summary: Determines the reference positon for the Photon and PBT CT scanners. The reference position for these scanners is the high density couch bar. The sup-inf level of the user origin is generally used as the reference z position, however, it may differ when bar cannot be found at that level. The high density couch bar is located by plotting horizontal HU profiles at various Ant/Post levels. This process is optimized by taking the lowest point of the body structure along the midline of the image (should be at level of couch) and plotting profiles from there and down. If the profile contains HU values above 1400, then it is assumed that is caused by the high density couch bar and the reference location is found.
